component.name: NekoSend
猫猫快传
component.summary: Chat-style file transfers on your local network
像聊天一样进行局域网文件传输

description.p: NekoSend discovers nearby devices and exchanges messages, files and folders over a trusted local IPv4 network. Transfers can be paused and resumed, and conversations and pending tasks are stored locally.
The application does not use a cloud relay or require an account. Local network traffic is not encrypted; use it only on a network you trust.
